display.purpose: Page titles only (PageHeader). 19px is the current display ceiling; larger lettering is named unspent headroom.

readout.purpose: Instrument values — money, counts, page numbers. Always B612 Mono, always tabular.

placard.purpose: Engraved caps micro-label under instruments, table headers, nav groups. Never a kicker, never introduces prose.

body.purpose: Default UI text; 12px for secondary lines.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Resting instrument face (night: machined edge-light + drop). Day value: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,24,29,0.06), 0 1px 1px rgba(20,24,29,0.04).

shadows.name: shadow-raise
shadows.purpose: Overlays (dialog, drawer, menu) and hover of linked instruments. Day: 0 12px 32px rgba(20,24,29,0.16), 0 4px 12px rgba(20,24,29,0.08).

shadows.name: shadow-glow
shadows.purpose: Phosphor engagement ring: button focus, solid button at rest.

shadows.name: lamp-bloom
shadows.purpose: Halo on lit lamps; per-status via --glow-ok/-caution/-alert/-advisory.

motion.name: needle
motion.purpose: Value elements rise 5px and settle with slight overshoot.

motion.name: power-on
motion.purpose: Panels warm up on first paint; dialogs use the same curve at 0.25s.

motion.name: drawer-in
motion.purpose: Drawer slides 24px from the logical end.

motion.name: transition-state
motion.purpose: Default duration for hover/press state transitions. prefers-reduced-motion collapses all animation globally.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Outlined phosphor ENGAGE button; lights up solid with glow on hover. The normal affirmative action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(57,255,154,0.6); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--phos, #39ff9a); font-family: 'B612', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: var(--phos, #39ff9a); background: var(--phos, #39ff9a); color: var(--phos-ink, #06180e); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--phos, #39ff9a), 0 0 12px rgba(57,255,154,0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--phos, #39ff9a), 0 0 12px rgba(57,255,154,0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Solid Button
components.description: Pre-lit phosphor button with glow at rest — the one most-important action on a screen (max one per screen).
components.css: .ds-btn-solid { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--phos, #39ff9a); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--phos-ink, #06180e); font-family: 'B612', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--phos, #39ff9a), 0 0 12px rgba(57,255,154,0.22); transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-solid:hover { background: var(--phos-bright, #63ffb1); } .ds-btn-solid:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Standby Button
components.description: Outlined neutral STANDBY button for cancel and alternate actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--bezel-strong, #303740); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink, #f2f5f2); font-family: 'B612', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--well, #0d1013); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Annunciator Lamps
components.description: The five-state status vocabulary: lit lamps bloom, off lamps sit dim. Replaces every pastel pill.
components.html: Paid Pending Overdue Scheduled Completed
components.css: .ds-lamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid; font-family: 'B612', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; line-height: 16px; } .ds-lamp-ok { border-color: rgba(57,255,154,0.3); background: rgba(57,255,154,0.1); color: var(--phos, #39ff9a); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(57,255,154,0.28); } .ds-lamp-caution { border-color: rgba(255,176,0,0.3); background: rgba(255,176,0,0.1); color: var(--caution, #ffb000); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,176,0,0.25); } .ds-lamp-alert { border-color: rgba(255,81,72,0.3); background: rgba(255,81,72,0.11); color: var(--alert, #ff5148); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,81,72,0.28); } .ds-lamp-advisory { border-color: rgba(85,200,240,0.3); background: rgba(85,200,240,0.1); color: var(--advisory, #55c8f0); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(85,200,240,0.25); } .ds-lamp-off { border-color: var(--bezel, #22272e); background: rgba(242,245,242,0.05); color: var(--dim, #a4adb6); }

components.name: Waypoint Input
components.description: Sunken-well text input with phosphor focus, under a bold dim label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; min-width: 240px; } .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: 'B612', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dim, #a4adb6); } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--well, #0d1013); border: 1px solid var(--bezel-strong, #303740); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink, #f2f5f2); font-family: 'B612', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--faint, #7d8894); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--phos, #39ff9a); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(57,255,154,0.25); }

components.description: Sidebar navigation row; active item lights lamp-ok background with a phosphor needle tick on the start edge.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; width: 220px; padding: 8px; background: var(--face, #111417); border: 1px solid var(--bezel, #22272e); border-radius: 10px; } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--dim, #a4adb6); font-family: 'B612', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--well, #0d1013); color: var(--ink, #f2f5f2); } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { background: rgba(57,255,154,0.1); color: var(--phos, #39ff9a); } .ds-needle { position: absolute; inset-inline-start: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 2px; height: 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--phos, #39ff9a); }

narrative.overview: An academy run like a night flight deck (direction: Night Six-Pack, seed 5b13a029). Every surface is a matte instrument panel; every number is a gauge reading in luminous mono; every status is a rectangular annunciator lamp that is either lit or dim. The world explicitly refuses the white-admin dashboard: no gradient heroes, no tinted icon cards, no pastel status pills. Density is high but calm — hairline bezels separate instruments, and color appears only when it means something. Night is the default theme; day is a daylight-cockpit remap of the same tokens, never a different design. RTL foundations are built in via logical properties. Named unspent headroom: glass-lens / brushed-bezel materials and display lettering beyond 19px.
keyCharacteristics: Matte night panel with fine machined grain; instrument faces raised by an inset edge-light, not by decoration.
Phosphor radio-green (#39ff9a) means engaged/ok; amber and red are reserved for real caution/alert conditions.
B612 (an Airbus cockpit typeface) everywhere; B612 Mono tabular numerals for every reading.
One component vocabulary across all 27 modules: face, placard, readout, lamp.

rules.name: The Reserved-Fire Rule
rules.body: Amber and red never decorate. They appear only when a real condition breaches (overdue, expired, no-show, alert threshold). A screen with nothing wrong shows no amber or red.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: New code uses token utilities exclusively — no raw hex, no Tailwind palette classes. The legacy-compat remap in app/globals.css is transitional, shrinks as modules migrate, and must never be relied on by new work.

rules.name: The Lamp Semantics Rule
rules.body: All status maps to exactly five meanings: ok (green), caution (amber), alert (red), advisory (cyan), off (dim neutral).

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every numeral is tabular; money and counts render in B612 Mono via the readout utility. Numbers align by construction, everywhere.

rules.name: The Placard Voice Rule
rules.body: Labels are engraved placards: short caps nouns. A placard labels a value or group; it never introduces prose and is never a decorative kicker. Buttons speak in caps imperative verbs.

rules.name: The Edge-Light Rule
rules.body: Night depth comes from edge-light and darkness, never from colored or blurred decoration.

rules.name: The Lit-vs-Printed Rule
rules.body: Anything luminous (lit lamp, solid button, focus ring) blooms; anything printed (text, borders) does not.

rules.name: The One Lit Button Rule
rules.body: At most one solid (pre-lit) button per screen.

dos: Do consume tokens only: surfaces from panel/face/raised/well, text from ink/dim/faint, borders from bezel — theme correctness in both worlds falls out automatically.
Do route every domain status through StatusBadge, and any new status through its map first.

Do keep the accessibility floor: 2px phosphor :focus-visible outline on everything, faint-on-face >=4.5:1, roles on gauges/dialogs/errors as built, text labels inside every lamp, reduced-motion respected.
Do use logical properties (start/end, ps/pe, ms/me, border-s/e) for anything horizontal — the Arabic/RTL pass must need no layout rework.
Do keep printables paper: black-on-white, chrome-free, inside .print-area.
donts: Don't use raw palette classes or hex in components — and don't lean on the legacy-compat remap; it is scaffolding scheduled for deletion.
Don't ship pastel status pills, tinted icon cards, or more than one solid (pre-lit) button per screen.
Don't use gradients as decoration. The only gradient in the world is the TickGauge's functional tick pattern; backgrounds, buttons, and headers stay flat.
Don't add kickers or decorative eyebrow text above titles; placards label instruments, nothing else.
Don't light amber/red without a breached condition, and don't invent status colors beyond the five lamp meanings.
